name: PangeaBench
description: PangeaBench is a holistic evaluation suite designed to assess multilingual multimodal large language models across 14 datasets covering 47 languages. It focuses on cross-cultural and linguistic diversity to evaluate model performance in multilingual and multimodal contexts.
reputation: A broad multilingual multimodal benchmark that is useful for cross-cultural evaluation, but it is still emerging and not yet a de facto standard.
notes: Includes 6M instruction dataset and covers 39 languages; emphasizes cultural relevance and multilingual multimodal tasks.
